TITLE: Katz says Israel waiting for 'green light' to renew war against Iran
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-17/18 (liveblog entry)
SOURCE: Times of Israel

KEY QUOTES — DEFENSE MINISTER ISRAEL KATZ:
- "Israel is prepared to renew the war against Iran. The IDF is ready in defense and offense, and the targets are marked"
- Israel is "awaiting a green light from the United States"
- Goal 1: "complete the elimination of the Khamenei dynasty, the initiator of the extermination plan against Israel"
- Goal 2: "return Iran to the age of darkness and stone by blowing up central energy and electricity facilities and crushing national economic infrastructure"
- "This time the attack will be different and deadly and will add devastating blows in the most painful places, following the enormous blows the Iranian terror regime has already suffered so far, that will shake and collapse its foundations"
